title: The Russians have slowly but surely carved out a little buff
author: Big Serge
cached_full_text:
【X推文】@Big Serge
The Russians have slowly but surely carved out a little buffer zone after the Kursk incursion, as they said they would. Unclear how they expect to fold this into a negotiated settlement to end the war. It’s not a big enough bargaining chip to get Ukraine to cede the Donbas.
